items.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Mobility (12 month FTC)
items.snippet: Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business. This is an initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa. The Impact – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍 The Opportunity 🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership 🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026) 🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year-on-year, with over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed and demand climbing 🌱 Real climate impact: Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents What You'll Do At M-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa. Technical Environment 💻 Languages & frameworks: C#/.NET Cloud: We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP Architecture: Event-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker Observability: Prometheus, Grafana Engineering culture: DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery AI tooling: We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow Our Engineering Approach 🚀 As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on: High quality output Observability and monitoring Automated testing in all environments, including production Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices What You Need We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development. Required Experience: Strong grasp of C# .NET development Experience with event-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Microservices architecture experience Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker) Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana Testing and deployment expertise DevOps culture mindset Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar Location & Benefits Initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa Professional development programs and coaching partnerships Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements Well-being support and career growth opportunities Our Mission 🌍 We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model, with M-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities. Legal Intern (m/f/d)
items.snippet: Über Buena Buena baut Technologie, die Hausverwaltung einfacher und transparenter macht. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihren Teams die Abläufe weiter. Wir verbinden Erfahrung vor Ort mit eigener Software, die im Alltag Arbeit abnimmt. Mit jeder weiteren Verwaltung wachsen auch die Anforderungen an unsere Prozesse – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Deine Rolle Als Legal Operations & Compliance Intern sorgst du gemeinsam mit unserem Legal Counsel dafür, dass Buena auch bei schnellem Wachstum rechtlich und organisatorisch gut aufgestellt ist. Du bringst Ordnung in Dokumente und offene Themen unserer Holding und Hausverwaltungen und setzt rechtliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit unseren Teams in konkrete Abläufe um. Du übernimmst eigene, klar abgegrenzte Aufgaben und arbeitest direkt mit Legal und unseren operativen Teams zusammen. Rechtliche Bewertungen und Entscheidungen liegen bei unserem Legal Counsel; du schaffst die Informationsgrundlage und bringst die Umsetzung voran. Du musst dafür kein Jura studieren und kein juristisches Vorwissen mitbringen. Ob du aus Business, Operations, Finance oder einem anderen analytischen Bereich kommst: Entscheidend ist, dass du schnell verstehst, sorgfältig arbeitest und Dinge zum Abschluss bringst. Den rechtlichen Kontext lernst du bei uns. Was du bei uns machst Überblick schaffen: Du erfasst Verträge, Genehmigungen und Nachweise unserer Gesellschaften und machst sichtbar, welche Informationen vorliegen und was noch fehlt. Themen voranbringen: Du beschaffst Unterlagen, stimmst dich mit unseren Teams und Hausverwaltungen ab und hältst offene Punkte bis zur Klärung nach. Bei Bedarf arbeitest du dafür auch vor Ort mit den Teams. Prüfungen und Umsetzung vorbereiten: Du bereitest Informationen für unseren Legal Counsel auf, koordinierst vereinbarte Compliance-Maßnahmen und dokumentierst den Fortschritt. Abläufe verbessern: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Legal einfache Standards, Übersichten und Workflows für wiederkehrende Aufgaben. Ein Beispiel: Du erstellst eine Übersicht der benötigten Nachweise mehrerer Hausverwaltungen, klärst mit den Teams fehlende Unterlagen und entwickelst mit Legal einen Ablauf, mit dem die Übersicht künftig aktuell bleibt. Was du mitbringst Du bringst Dinge zum Abschluss: Du gehst Aufgaben selbstständig an, klärst offene Fragen und bleibst dran. Du behältst den Überblick: Auch bei vielen Dokumenten, Gesellschaften und offenen Themen arbeitest du strukturiert. Du arbeitest sorgfältig: Du prüfst Informationen, erkennst Widersprüche und gehst Unklarheiten nach. Du weißt, wann du Rücksprache brauchst: Du arbeitest eigenständig und holst dir bei Unsicherheit rechtzeitig Unterstützung. Du kommunizierst klar: Du hältst Absprachen ein, berichtest über Fortschritte und sprichst Hindernisse früh an. Du nutzt Technologie sicher: Du arbeitest mit Excel oder Google Sheets und gängigen KI-Tools. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch. Was du bei uns lernst und bewegen kannst Direkt mit Legal arbeiten: Du bekommst unmittelbares Feedback von unserem Legal Counsel und lernst, wie rechtliche Anforderungen im operativen Geschäft umgesetzt werden. Eigene Verantwortung übernehmen: Du betreust Aufgaben vom ersten Überblick bis zum Abschluss. Wenn du gute Arbeit machst, wächst deine Verantwortung. Ergebnisse schaffen, die bleiben: Die Standards und Abläufe, an denen du mitarbeitest, helfen den Teams unserer gesamten Gruppe. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Büro, stimmen uns direkt ab und legen Wert darauf, einander gut zu kennen. Deine Benefits Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du in Büronähe wohnst. 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat. 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, anteilig. but the global stack of Dataiku is <strong>Python/Java</strong> for the backend and <strong>Angular/Vue/React</strong> for the frontend.</p> <p>Here are <strong>some examples </strong>of previous projects our interns worked on:</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Unsupervised models:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Improve the tooling available for data scientists to train unsupervised (clustering) models in Dataiku</li> <li>If time allows, extend further to optimize the training and inference of those types of models</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Webapp vibe coding:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Build an intelligent “vibe coding” assistant that interprets a user’s intent and aesthetic preferences to automatically generate items.snippet: About Nabla We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine. Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows. Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere. This is a great time to join us! Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill. Location: Paris (Hybrid) Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible) Commitment: Internship-to-hire What we Offer Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products. Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together. Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter. Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly. We work across multiple domains: Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems Your DNA Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field . Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript . Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features. Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn. Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow. Nice-to-Haves (but not required) Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems. Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure. Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing. You’ll see us on campus at: Télécom Paris Forum Trium ENSIMAG CentraleSupélec École Polytechnique EPFL Forum Organisation Meet us there and tell us what excites you. Life at Nabla When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed. We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes. We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts! If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application! Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. items.snippet: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware. The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one. This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes. What You'll Work On Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities. Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather. Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer. Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts. Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions. Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation. Who We're Looking For We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites. Your Background Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field. Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project. Strong coding skills in Python. Hands-on experience with ROS 2. Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows. Nice to Have Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged. Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion. Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo. Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL). What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world. Growth Opportunity This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.
